definition: selectDegree (q eps:Rat) (cap:Nat):Option Nat := (List.range (cap+1)).find? (fun n => decide (2*radius q n <= eps))
signature: theorem selectDegree_sound (q eps:Rat)(cap n:Nat)(h:selectDegree q eps cap=some n): n<=cap /\ 2*radius q n<=eps
classification: C internal provider; h is exact computable producer-success equation, not trigonometric containment nor any source Anchor assumption
semantics: Literal finite search of degrees 0..cap in order. None is honest cap failure; never mathematical impossibility or source-parameter exclusion. Success plus unconditional scalar roots supplies membership and width at most eps. Negative eps is allowed but cannot produce a false soundness claim.
boundaries: No guarantee every cap succeeds; no uniform runtime theorem. Python decoder/parser, exact decimal transport and stage/circuit action remain separate. No frozen prior seal/source changed.
